# FunnyBloxy's Academic Comeback!

> Small private tuition in Mauritius for Cambridge O Level Accounting (7707), Business (7081), Economics (2281) and Computer Science (2210), preparing students for the November 2027 exams. AS and A Level coming later.

The public part of the site is the home page only. Lessons, quizzes, homework and progress are behind a Discord sign-in and need the tutor's approval.

## What students get
- Chapter-by-chapter notes that follow the syllabus, plus the tutor's own class notes
- Practice quizzes, speedruns, daily and weekly challenges, streaks and badges
- Live 1v1 / 2v2 quiz battles
- Homework hand-in with marks, feedback and worked solutions
- Parent progress reports

## Join
Ask in the Discord server (link on the home page).
